subject: Appeal: expired promo credits and temporary sandbox restore for Aurora AI pilot
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@aurora-ai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Appeal — expired promo credits and temporary sandbox restore for Aurora AI pilot

Hi Sergio,

We noticed our promo credits on the Aurora AI pilot account expired on Nov 28th while we were mid-integration. This pilot is critical to our production timeline — we were running evaluation cohorts and a subset of our tests exhausted the sandbox tokens.

Can Redwood make a one-time restoration or short extension so we can finish the final integration checks? Specifically, we request a temporary reissue of 30,000 tokens (or equivalent $ credit) and sandbox access re-enabled for 30 days. If you need more context: we started the pilot Sept 12, integration stalled in late Oct due to infra changes.

I attached a small usage extract for your reference (usage-report.csv). Happy to hop on a 20–30 min call if useful.

Thanks,
Alex Wu
Head of ML Ops | Aurora AI
alex.wu@aurora-ai.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: usage-report.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@aurora-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Appeal — expired promo credits and temporary sandbox restore for Aurora AI pilot

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the usage snapshot.

I can escalate a one-time remediation, but I need signoff on the amount and a short operational plan from Sales. My initial recommendation is to restore 20,000 tokens and enable the sandbox for 30 days while we monitor for any unusual activity. If that looks insufficient after a week, we can revisit.

Marissa / Karthik — tagging you both for approval. Is a 20k token reissue OK from a commercial perspective? Any procurement or SLA caveats we should flag (legal/finance)? If yes, I will proceed to re-enable the sandbox and log the credit against RDW-20349.

Alex — I can also send a DocuSign for an updated PO if Procurement needs that.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

Sergio — I reviewed the account and the usage CSV. Given Aurora is mid-integration and this is a high-velocity pilot, approve a one-time 25,000-token credit with a 30-day sandbox reactivation. Conditions:

- Credit assigned to deal RDW-20349 and logged in CRM.
- 30-day monitoring window; if we see anomalous spikes outside the normal cohort tests, we reserve the right to throttle.
- Procurement must accept a short confirmation email (no new SLA changes).

Karthik — please add the attached SLA extract to the deal folder and flag finance for billing reconciliation. I’m attaching the internal review PDF for reference (aurora_sla_review.pdf).

Once finance confirms, Sergio please confirm back to Alex and restore the tokens.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: aurora_sla_review.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Appeal — expired promo credits and temporary sandbox restore for Aurora AI pilot

Alex — good news: Marissa approved a one-time 25,000-token reissue and sandbox access has been re-enabled for 30 days. We logged this under RDW-20349. Details below: 

- Credit: 25,000 tokens applied to Aurora AI pilot account (one-time, non-recurring).
- Effective: immediate (sandbox access restored).
- Monitoring: Redwood will monitor usage for 30 days and reach out if we observe anomalous patterns.
- Next steps for Aurora: confirm which environment you want reconnected (staging vs sandbox) and we will provide a temporary key.

Procurement — if you need a PO or confirmation email for your records, reply and we’ll provide the brief confirmation note.

Doc links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/RDW-20349 (deal), https://drive.redwood.com/shared/aurora-sla (SLA extract).

Thanks everyone — ping me if you’d like a quick troubleshooting call while you finish integration.

Best,
